In Jan 2025, I quit from a mid-size insurance tech company(1000+) after working there for almost 4y, because I was tipped off the they were about to start layoffs and they did. Well, since then I have zero luck finding any job in SWE. At this point, I have massive gap in my resume that I can't explain to recruiters, I can still code (C#/.NET/AWS) and learned the AI, but who cares if date of my last employment is Jan2025. What should I do ? If you have an alternative path (something completely different from SWE or SWE adjacent) that pays "well", I would like to hear.
